scope: Bounded observation of an audited ODA 27.1.0 AC1018 conversion of an ezdxf acad_table_simple.dxf; not native producer or semantic support qualification.
capture: Actual reader import with base dx_iface callbacks forwarded; source publication and typed baseline matched for dictionary and XRECORD; children captured as unsupported opaque source frames. Offsets below are in decoded object buffer, not physical file offsets.

source_observations.standard_facets: 0xbb and 0xbc: publication seen, payload matched, immutable typed baseline, source profile bound

graph: TABLE 0x9c hard-owner H code 3 to dictionary 0xbb; dictionary parent soft-pointer H code 4 to TABLE and key ACAD_XREC_ROUNDTRIP entry H code 2 to XRECORD 0xbc. XRECORD parent and reactor soft-pointer H code 4 to 0xbb. Embedded group 360/361 values are data-block uint64 references, not DWG H tokens; LibreDWG reports each child owner 0xbc.

xrecord_verifier.limitation: Pinned body-to-source association requires a separate actual-read capture receipt.

independent_walk: tools/research/p5_ac1018_table_xrecord_source_verify.py: pinned source and body hashes, all ordered values and spans, common prefix, owner/reactor roles, body end and padding. Self-test rejects five bit mutations and one truncation. Hash pinning does not independently authenticate body-to-drawing association.
crc_provenance: Actual reader DwgObjectFrame::readAt validates stored CRC16 when acquiring each frame before publication; callback body omits prefix and stored CRC. The independent walker does not verify CRC or establish capture association.
string_discrepancy: The three strings have RS little-endian length then RC codepage byte 45 in this observed body. LibreDWG decode.c at commit 6d6a3398 follows RS then RC; ODA v5.4.1 section 20.4.104 text specifies RC then RC for R13–R2004. The value 45 is not semantically qualified by ASCII bytes; typed output substitutes codepage 0.
writer_authority: Existing ordered XRECORD entries are authoritative when nonempty; legacy scalar/handle views are fallback compatibility views. A global mirror-consistency requirement or forcing known pairs into raw mode would change supported consumers. Source-bound replay must separately compare every captured view and require no mutation.
limitations: No semantic support claim, native acceptance, complete subtree graph, AC1018 descendant field decoding, output replay or general profile is established. TABLECONTENT and TABLEGEOMETRY documented introduction is later than this compatibility source; do not apply later schema blindly. Physical populated graph remains refused.
next_slice: Build a private immutable opt-in capability from the matched completed-import standard facet and a unique generation token; bind verified frame identity/body, CRC provenance, type/version and deep typed snapshot. Exercise valid/invalid CRC, wrong generation, coincident identities, mutation, rollback and retry. Do not expose or enable physical subtree replay before opaque descendants and closure are proven.
